Beyond the philosophical implications of the concept, the performance struck at a key nerve of classical music culture — a delicate balancing of tradition and relevance. [...] At the center of Machover’s composition philosophy is his belief that classical music finds a natural extension and innovation in technology. He revealed in an interview with GBH music that the music he hears in his head is often beyond the scope of traditional instruments. Phát hiện này góp phần làm dấy lên nghi vấn về đích đến thực sự của những lô thiết bị AI có giá trị lớn mà Megaspeed và các công ty liên quan mua. [...] Megaspeed được tách ra từ một công ty trò chơi điện tử của Trung Quốc vào năm 2023. Công ty hoạt động trong lĩnh vực trung tm dữ liệu, cung cấp dịch vụ cho thuê năng lực tính toán sử dụng chip Nvidia, trong đó có khách hàng là các doanh nghiệp Trung Quốc.

https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads

- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
